page.overview:
Who is Lo Yang?

Lo Yang (ロー・ヤン Ro Yan) is a character from Street Fighter II V.

He is a Chinese martial artist from the dojo of Chun Li's father, Dorai. He fought against Chun Li at the dojo in a sparring match and lost.
